sop_name: Search and Seizure under the NDPS Act
objective: To ensure lawful search, seizure, sampling, storage and reporting of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances in accordance with the NDPS Act, 1985 and associated rules.

legal_basis.purpose: Power to issue warrants and authorizations.
Search, seizure and arrest based on prior information in buildings, conveyances or enclosed places.
Search and seizure in public places.
Power to stop and search conveyances.
Disposal and reporting after arrest and seizure.
Disposal, inventory, photography and sampling of seized narcotic drugs.
Reporting of arrest and seizure to superior officers.

procedure.title: Record Intelligence
procedure.description: Record information received regarding narcotic offences as required under Section 42 before initiating action where applicable.

procedure.title: Obtain Authorization
procedure.description: Obtain warrant or authorization under Section 41 whenever required. Emergency searches shall follow provisions of Section 42.

procedure.title: Identify Search Location
procedure.description: Determine whether the search is in a public place (Section 43) or a private building, conveyance or enclosed place (Section 42).

procedure.title: Conduct Personal Search
procedure.description: Where personal search is required, comply with safeguards provided under Section 50.

procedure.title: Search Premises or Vehicle
procedure.description: Conduct systematic search while documenting all recovered narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and related evidence.

procedure.title: Prepare Inventory
procedure.description: Prepare inventory of seized material including description, quantity, packaging, identifying marks and seizure location in accordance with Section 52A.

procedure.title: Photography and Sampling
procedure.description: Photograph seized material and draw representative samples following the NDPS Seizure, Storage, Sampling and Disposal Rules, 2022.

procedure.title: Seal Evidence
procedure.description: Seal all exhibits using tamper-evident methods and assign unique evidence identifiers.

procedure.title: Deposit in Safe Custody
procedure.description: Deposit seized articles in the designated malkhana or authorized storage facility as required under Section 55.

procedure.title: Submit Report
procedure.description: Forward seizure and arrest report to the immediate superior officer within the prescribed time under Section 57.

references: NDPS (Seizure, Storage, Sampling and Disposal) Rules, 2022
